cloud-migration.title: Cloud Migration & Modernization
cloud-migration.short_description: Seamless lift-and-shift of standard VMs and deep modernization of legacy database workloads.
cloud-migration.long_description: We specialize in both rehosting (lift-and-shift of standard virtual machines) and refactoring (modernizing complex legacy databases like Oracle and SQL Server to modern cloud-native managed services). Our approach minimizes downtime, optimizes cloud spend, and ensures business continuity.
highlights: Oracle & SQL Server modernization to cloud-native DBs

app-development.title: App Development & Full PDLC
app-development.short_description: End-to-end product development life cycle backed by modern CI/CD pipelines.
app-development.long_description: Our application development services span the entire Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC). From requirement ideation and UI/UX design to robust CI/CD automated deployments, automated testing, and comprehensive real-time monitoring.
highlights: Robust CI/CD pipeline automation (GitHub Actions, GitLab)
Agile delivery with predictable release schedules

data-analytics.title: Enterprise Data Analytics
data-analytics.short_description: Data protection, compliance, audit trails, and multi-platform enterprise analytics.
data-analytics.long_description: Unlock the true value of your data while keeping security front and center. We implement end-to-end data pipelines incorporating enterprise-grade data protection policies, secure auditing, and granular logging across diverse platforms.
highlights: Data protection and localized residency compliance
Granular auditing and security event logging
